title: Finite tensor expansion with independent right factors
statement: Let k be a field and M,N be k-vector spaces. For every z∈M⊗ₖN, there exist a natural number n and families v:Fin n→M and w:Fin n→N such that w is k-linearly independent and z=Σᵢ vᵢ⊗wᵢ. The index set may be empty.
lean_statement: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module k N] (z : TensorProduct k M N), ∃ (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → M) (w : Fin n → N), LinearIndependent k w ∧ z = ∑ i : Fin n, TensorProduct.tmul k (v i) (w i)
